strategy: Emerge Eldrazi payoffs fed by undying/recursive sac fodder and a self-mill/graveyard-ramp support shell
identity: Sacrifice cheap undying and recursive creatures to cast six colorless Emerge Eldrazi at a steep discount, using self-mill and Cryptolith Rite to fuel and fix a grindy three-color ramp shell.
